GALACTICGUARD

Defending the Smart Lunar Building

Designing a secure and reliable network that protects a smart lunar building from cyber attacks and keeps communication with Earth safe.

EXPLORE MISSION →VIEW NETWORKS

OUR MISSION

Life on the Moon depends on connected technology. Our mission is to protect the systems that keep a smart lunar building operational and its communication with Earth secure.

◉

Air Systems

Life-support systems must remain available and protected.

♨

Temperature

Climate-control systems help protect people and equipment.

⌁

Communications

Critical voice, telemetry, video, and data links.

▣

Mission Data

Research and operational information must remain secure.

⚙

Control Systems

Connected building systems need reliable access controls.

⚠ THE PROBLEM

A cyber attack could disrupt critical lunar systems, compromise important data, or interfere with communication between the Moon and Earth.

WHY IT MATTERS

The smart lunar building depends on interconnected systems. Cybersecurity must be designed into the network from the beginning.

Keep it connected. Keep it secure. Keep it operational.

LUNAR CHALLENGES

Cybersecurity on the Moon must work with limited resources and a harsh environment.

☢

Radiation

Radiation can affect electronic equipment and system reliability.

ϟ

Limited Power

Security systems must be efficient with available energy.

⌁

Limited Bandwidth

Communication capacity between the Moon and Earth is limited.

◷

Communication Delays

Earth cannot instantly respond to everything happening on the Moon.

How do we build strong cybersecurity when power, bandwidth, hardware, and communication are limited?

OUR DEFENSE

A layered defense combines multiple controls so one failure does not expose the entire lunar building.

◆

Secure Networks

Keep systems separated and protected.

▦

Firewalls

Control what network traffic is allowed.

◉

Intrusion Detection

Monitor activity and alert to suspicious behavior.

▣

Encryption

Protect sensitive data across the network.

●

Access Control

Limit critical systems to authorized users and devices.

WORKING SOFTWARE DEMONSTRATION · DEVELOPMENT CHECKPOINT

GALACTIC GUARD APP PROTOTYPE

Galactic Guard Mission Control is our Python desktop application for demonstrating cybersecurity in a future smart lunar building. Built with CustomTkinter, it displays simulated Life Support, Crew Network, Communications, and Earth Link systems. Its rule-based firewall checks the source and destination of each simulated connection against an approved list, allowing known connections and blocking unknown ones by default. The dashboard changes its threat indicator, displays an animated security terminal, and records each event with a timestamp.

PYTHON + CUSTOMTKINTERRULE-BASED FIREWALLACCESS CONTROLSECURITY EVENT LOGGINGSIMULATED LUNAR SYSTEMS

✓ Authorized access · ALLOW

Mission Control requests access to Life Support. The connection matches an approved firewall rule, so the application allows it. The terminal turns green and the event is logged.

⚠ Unauthorized access · BLOCK

An Unknown Device attempts to access Life Support. No rule permits this connection, so the firewall blocks it. The terminal turns red, the threat indicator rises, and the attempt is logged.

01 · Monitor

A single dashboard displays four simulated lunar systems and the result of the latest connection test.

02 · Decide

The firewall checks each source–destination pair against its allowlist. Unlisted connections are denied by default.

03 · Record

Animated red or green terminal messages explain the decision. A timestamped event log preserves the session's connection history.

Project progress: We have reached approximately 50% of our planned software prototype. These screenshots show a simulated defense demonstration, not live monitoring of real lunar hardware. Future work includes more advanced security features, expanded testing, and possible engineering integration. The LOW/HIGH indicator currently reflects the most recent simulation.
